row.title: retriage and org-profile probe ran weekly; their issues sat open for days (SLA-ISSUE-1)
row.body: scripts/retriage.sh was documented as every 3 h but its cron is weekly (budget), so the rolling Retriage gaps issue (#2032) never refreshed; org-profile-probe is weekly, never closes its own issue and grepped for 'runs itself', a phrase absent from the profile README (#2033). Both now run from the 10-minute fleet clock; scripts/org_profile_probe.sh closes its issue on pass and checks the README headline.
